title: Knowledge Search Request/Response
description: This contract is single-Knowledge only (SearchRequest.knowledge_id is exactly one AssetVersion per call) — it has no notion of searching across multiple Knowledge assets. `POST /api/v1/knowledge-search` in packages/schemas/api/portal-openapi.yaml (M02, apps/portal-api/src/portal_api/routers/knowledge_search.py) is the multi-Knowledge caller built on top of this contract: it resolves the caller's visible APPROVED Knowledge from the Registry, calls this service's `/search/v1/query` once per Knowledge (using this file's SearchRequest/Citation/SearchResult shapes unchanged), and merges the resulting Citations, additively stamping `knowledge_id`/`asset_id`/`asset_name`/`source` onto each one. No behavior change to this schema itself — doc note only, added alongside the new endpoint (see D-046/D-062 for the access_context/relevance-threshold behavior this schema already documents, which the new endpoint reuses as-is per Knowledge).

metadata_filters.description: Business (non-ACL) metadata equality filters only. `classification` (or any future field in the central ACL field list — see packages/security-policy Classification/ACL_METADATA_FIELDS) is rejected with KNOWLEDGE_ACCESS_DENIED if present here — see 04-knowledge-platform.md §3.8 and access_context below.

retrieval_profile.description: D-062: an optional, possibly-partial, already-resolved Retrieval Profile dict (retrieval-profile.schema.json subset) — no Profile Registry exists in this PoC (same D-053 shape as indexing-runtime's `profile` field), so this is caller-supplied JSON in the same request. Only `metadata_filters` (§3.8 step 3, Profile Default Filter) is read; it is subject to the same ACL-field rejection as the top-level `metadata_filters` above.

access_context.description: 04-knowledge-platform.md §3.8 step 1. Optional on the wire for backward compatibility with callers that predate this feature — omitting it resolves to the least-privileged clearance (PUBLIC_INTERNAL), never to 'no check' or 'see everything'. If present, `clearance` must be one of the four real levels (never UNKNOWN — a caller cannot assert 'my clearance is unknown') or the request is rejected with KNOWLEDGE_ACCESS_DENIED. HONESTY NOTE (D-062, D-015): search-runtime has no authentication — `clearance` is asserted by the caller (agent-runtime, forwarding its Run's user_context) and is never independently verified against a real identity/session in this PoC.

min_relevance_score.description: D-046: cosine-similarity floor applied after RRF fusion. 0 disables filtering. Defaults to search-runtime's policy setting (see retrieval-profile.schema.json min_relevance_score) when omitted.

query_instruct_prefix.description: D-046: text prepended to the query only (never to indexed documents) before embedding. Defaults to search-runtime's policy setting when omitted.

similarity.description: D-046: cosine similarity (1 - Chroma distance) of this chunk's vector match, the value min_relevance_score filters on. null when the chunk was found only via BM25 (no vector match) and filtering was disabled — a BM25-only chunk is dropped, not returned as null, whenever filtering is enabled.

min_relevance_score_applied.description: D-046: the min_relevance_score actually used for this search (request override or search-runtime's default).
